correctness.rationale: Threshold-three degree-four dynamics equals parallel degree-at-most-one pruning of the complement. Induced forests of cycle squares are characterized by cyclic gaps; the sharp size bound and complete residue-class enumeration prove all state counts. Two induced-path lengths give exact parallel completion times. Independent exhaustive infection checks for n=5..18 and separate gap/acyclicity checks for n=5..32 agree with theorem.
